title: Field3 authentic C6 runner
objective: Publish an authenticated native field3 prepared-embedding owner and execute exactly one C6 candidate attempt with immutable ancestry and terminal atomicity

oracles: PARI 2.17.4 low-precision getfu differential and exact owner replay

handoff.summary: Added a no-retry native runner which publishes an immutable prepared-embedding owner, executes one C6 getfu candidate, delegates exact result replay to the existing C6 coordinator, and emits the downstream factorback-source owner only after success. Focused transport, mutation, atomicity, capacity, and pristine-PARI low-precision differential checks pass without launching the authentic computation.
risks: The authentic 153088-bit native attempt is intentionally not executed in this lane.
The cold factorback verifier currently caps its independent logarithm replay at 384 bits, so its authentic precision extension remains separate work.

Broad native and strict suites require a clean integrated build; an accidentally requested broad test:changed build was interrupted immediately at compiler convergence to respect this lane's no-heavy-build constraint, leaving this worktree dist unsuitable for broad validation.
next_steps: Integrate this commit into the current integration tip and build the embedding and C6 source graphs in isolated content-addressed caches.
Run the documented command once under the 600-second, 4-GiB aggregate process-tree guard after authentic C5 publication.
On success, feed the emitted factorback-source and C6 owner to the separately precision-extended cold verifier before C7 publication.
